text:
tamara-recruiter: Quick help needed. Internal promotion approved 2026-03-15 with effective date 2026-03-01 but payroll closed for March. Manager wants retro pay + benefits start 3/1.

lucy-peopleops: Thanks. What were old/new bands and comp? Is there signed manager approval?

tamara-recruiter: Band moved M1 -> M2. Base 118000 -> 132000. Manager signed through DocuSign earlier today (link attached).

alejandro-finance: We'll need GL movement. Who should absorb backpay, current or new team?

sam-engineering-manager: Please charge receiving org ENG-OPS (EO-7010). Manager confirms backpay responsibility.

nina-hr: Benefits: carriers allow backdating to the first of month but need retro paperwork and carrier approval. If we cant get carrier sign-off, fallback to 4/1.

payrollops: Off-cycle required. Please submit off-cycle template with gross delta and EmpID. Tax will be applied in the off-cycle run.

lucy-peopleops: Tamara, use this snippet and attach attestation: 
RequestType: Off-cycle backpay
Employee: <redacted name>
EmpID: 45211
OldBase: 118000
NewBase: 132000
MonthlyDelta: 1166.67
ManagerSignOff: link
CostCenterCharge: EO-7010
BenefitsRequest: retro 3/1 pending carrier approval OR effective 4/1

tamara-recruiter: Submitted to payrollops and attached DocuSign.

payrollops: Ticket OC-176395-03 created. Scheduling off-cycle 2026-04-02 if docs complete. Will include YTD tax recalc. Will update with net estimate.

alejandro-finance: We'll prepare ledger transfer once payroll posts. Confirm whether to retro-adjust any bonus proration.
sam-engineering-manager: No bonuses involved. Just base uplift.

lucy-peopleops: Noted. Nina, will Benefits escalate to carrier for 3/1?

nina-hr: Escalating now. If approved, we'll instruct payroll to treat benefits as retroactive. If denied, benefits effective 4/1.

tamara-recruiter: Thanks team. Please ping here once OC run scheduled. :pray:
